# Build Guide: Heavy Weapons with Bullet Storm, VATS, Critical Hits, Cripple

![Build Guide: Heavy Weapons with Bullet Storm, VATS, Critical Hits, Cripple](/uploads/582_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Play Style:** Human | hail of bullets | V.A.T.S. | Critical Hits | crippling | High DPS | Full life

The changes to the perk cards for the **heavy weapons** have now been completed, so we can now introduce a build for heavy weapons that can be used in the long term.

This build primarily plays with **full health** and **heavy weapons**. **Power armor** is not absolutely necessary, but it improves one or two situations. So you are **flexible** when it comes to your personal preferences when it comes to power armor. The primary weapons I use here are heavy energy weapons with **large magazine for the hail of bullets bonus**: the **Gauss Minigun** is the best choice here. Gatling plasma or Gatling laser are of course also possible. And if you use weapon belt, you can also play ballistic heavy weapons like the Kal 50 machine gun or the LMG. It is also easily possible to play this build bloodstained in order to improve all SPECIALs with the Unyielding Armor and thereby gain advantages such as: to get more action points, more luck or more intelligence.

The bonuses this build works with are:

- Bullet hail with up to 90% bonus after 10 stacks*You get 9% bonus damage for every 30 shots fired. Max 10 stacks are achieved after 300 shots.*
- *Critical hits in VATS* increase our damage enormously. Bonuses of over 300% on critical hits are easily possible. By using VATS, we hit much more accurately and use less ammunition.
- *Crippling* stops the enemies quickly and thus prevents damage taken, at the same time we receive up to an average of around 175% more damage from perks from crippled opponents.
- Additional bonuses such as adrenaline allow even more damage to be increased.

*The build is basically also suitable for ghouls, but there will be a separate build guide here after the next update.*

## Weapons

The primary weapon here is a **Gauss Minigun** with the legendary mods: Frenzied, Vital, Optimized V.A.T.S. and The Leader. The goal is to use the onslaught effect to achieve as much damage as possible on critical hits in VATS.

Other weapons with these legendary mods are also possible, but usually offer less damage.

![Gauss Minigun](/uploads/nukaknights-post-build-heavy-bulletstorm-gauss-minigun-de.jpg)

## Armor

The **Power Armor** is a **Vulcan** with the legendary mods: The Wolverine or The Aristocrat, Powered, Tru-Hikers and Border Crossing.

As a result, we accelerate AP regeneration by +50%, get +25% more durability on fusion cores and land significantly more critical hits by exceeding the limit (ideally every 2nd hit). The legendary mod "**The Glutton**" gives us +200TP if we are well fed (which we can easily achieve permanently with **Perfect Chewing Gums**). Alternatively, with "The Aristocrat" we get a **damage reduction of 25%** (at 34k caps) **up to 50%** (at 40k caps).
